scope: UV preparation code only; generated from an unsaved Blender 5.0.1 scratch session loading the frozen v3 blend.

audit.method: Exact UV triangle clipping with positive area > 1e-10; triangles belonging to the same source n-gon are excluded because their mutual interior is tessellation, not overlapping surfaces.
audit.unit_tiles: Each mesh part is independently packed into its own unit tile. This is not a shared final pixel-art atlas.

repair: Preserve structural seams and broad charts; isolate only faces in exact cross-face overlap hits, smart-project the selected subset with BMesh selection-count assertions, then average island scale and repack. A final local correction handles any narrow face collapsed by that repack. Original custom corner normals are restored after all UV operations.
not_proof_of: Final pixel texture quality, texel-density approval, Godot import/runtime, animation, or visual art acceptance.
